caption: Your partner cheated. Should you forgive or move on? #usahealth #wellness #wellnessjourney #selflove
transcript: Your partner cheated. Should you forgive or should you move on? My friend, everyone will give you an answer. Your friends will say leave. Your heart will say stay. But listen carefully. This was never a question about them. It is a question about you. Do not ask. Do they deserve forgiveness? Ask instead. Can I stay without punishing them every day? Because staying while your heart keeps a knife in its hand is not forgiveness. It is a slow war, and a slow war destroys both soldiers. And do not ask. Can I live without them? You can. You lived before them. Ask instead. Can I live with what I now know? Some people can. Truly. They rebuild. And the second house is stronger than the first. Some people cannot. And pretending is not strength, my friend. Pretending is just pain with patience. So sit quietly. Ask your body, not your fear. The body always knows. If peace returns when you imagine staying, stay and forgive fully. If peace returns only when you imagine leaving, then love yourself enough to go. Forgiveness and goodbye are not opposites. Sometimes they are the same door. You can forgive someone and still never hold their hand again.
